records.summary: Added the third native-lending amendment, LendingProtocolV1_1, to the XRPL collateral research. The live dashboard says XLS-66 LendingProtocol and XLS-65 SingleAssetVault are the core requirements for native lending; XLS-66d V1_1 adds closed-ended vaults and cash-basis accounting, and the loan-broker board waits for all three. The exact V1_1 vote count was not available. This supplements, rather than reverses, the conclusion that native lending is not yet live.
actions: Reopened the live XRPL Dashboard lending page and inspected its amendment and loan-broker-board requirements.
Cross-checked the current XRPLWin vote pages for LendingProtocol and SingleAssetVault.
Added the third amendment without inventing its vote count.
Preserved the prior two-amendment correction and clarified the core protocol versus closed-ended-vault extension.
blockers: LendingProtocolV1_1 exact vote count not retrieved.
No native loan-broker board or collateral objects are live/verified.
next_actions: Track all three amendment states and exact vote counts.
Do not attribute vault/loan-broker objects or collateral to raRVLN until activation and ledger object reads succeed.
